ETH is the higher-beta liquid expression of a crypto-specific regulatory re-rating than BTC. Forward commitment: long ETH from 2439.65, stop 2340 (4.1% / 1R), target 2690 (10.3% / 2.5R) over 72h. Honest prior: much of a risk-on impulse is priced within hours; this is a hypothesis that a regulatory+liquidity alignment carries a small survivable follow-through, falsified if 2340 prints first.

Honest prior: the crude move may already be in the tape and a tariff-threat oil bid can reverse fast; falsified if 161.80 prints first.
